component.name: OpenClaw
component.summary: All your chats, one OpenClaw - AI Assistant and Gateway

description.p: OpenClaw is an extensible personal AI assistant and unified communication gateway designed to automate workflows and coordinate interactions across various chat channels directly from your local system.

ul.li: Unified communication interface connecting messaging platforms with local terminal environments.
Local gateway daemon management with real-time health checks and status diagnostics.
Extensible plugin ecosystem for automated agent actions and chat management.
Seamless desktop integration and command-line orchestration.
